submission.justification: Sensor-T1 at 150 um gives the best single-hit spatial resolution of the candidates that satisfy the radiation requirement: 8.92 um, compared with 9.425 um for T1 at 100 um and 13.744 um for the best T2 point (200 um). Sensor-T3 is excluded because its hit efficiency at the innermost-layer fluence of 2e16 neq/cm2 is 82%, below the 97% minimum. Sensor-T1 retains 98.5% hit efficiency at that fluence, which clears the 97% requirement. Sensor-T2 reaches 99.2% efficiency but resolves worse at every tested thickness. The 150 um thickness lies within the 50–300 um constraint. The resolution figures are unirradiated values; resolution after irradiation was not recorded, so that is the main open point.
